story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Badge displays on each card in the **card footer** (first/left position). NOTE: This overrides the Epic 1 AC #1 wording ("top-right corner") — see Dev Notes → "AC Discrepancy Resolution". Architecture ADR-005 + UX Spec mandate footer placement. 2. Four badge variants are implemented with Remix Icon `-line` glyphs and a text label: - 🌱 Seedling → `ri-seedling-line` - 🌿 Budding → `ri-plant-line` - 🌳 Evergreen → `ri-tree-line` - 💀 Withered → `ri-skull-line` 3. Stage-specific color is applied to the **icon** (not the background) per UX spec: - Seedling `$growth-seedling: hsl(152, 76%, 50%)` - Budding `$growth-budding: hsl(189, 90%, 50%)` - Evergreen `$growth-evergreen: hsl(152, 76%, 33%)` (matches existing `$success`) - Withered `$growth-withered: hsl(0, 0%, 50%)` 4. Tooltip shows full stage name + brief description on hover and keyboard focus (e.g., `title="Seedling — early/draft content"`). 5. Badge renders in **list view** (every card via `_partials/card.html` footer) and in **single page view** (article header metadata row, near date/categories). 6. Badge is accessible: - Icon marked decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`), text label provides semantics for screen readers. - Tooltip exposed via the `title` attribute on the wrapper element (keyboard-focusable not required because badge is non-interactive). - WCAG-AA contrast verified against card background. 7. Mobile responsive: text label hidden on `< 600px` (`@include helpers.mobile { span { display: none; } }`); icon-only with `title` tooltip preserves a11y. 8. Default fallback: badge consumes `default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage` (pattern established by Story 1.1) — articles missing the field render as Seedling without error. 9. No regressions to existing card variants: `.is-horizontal`, `.is-log`, `.has-image`, top-right `.is-new` / `.visited` badges, and category ribbons all render unchanged.

doc.section: ADR-005: Growth Badge Placement (Card Footer) — lines 1400–1428
doc.snippet: "Place growth stage badge in card footer (first position, left side), not top corner." tests.standards:
Authoritative test plan: `docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md` (Test Architect Murat, 2025-11-15). Stack: Playwright (E2E + visual regression via `toHaveScreenshot()` + axe-core a11y) + Node test runner (`node --test`) for build/script unit tests. Story 1.1 bootstrapped this infrastructure (Playwright config, smoke spec, npm scripts, CI workflow); Story 1.2 ADDS the first real visual-regression suite.
Visual-regression strategy: 4 growth stages × 2 viewports (desktop 1280×800, mobile 375×667) = 8 baseline screenshots covering both card-list (homepage) and single-page contexts. Plus a missing-field assertion that the default fallback path renders Seedling. Baselines committed under `tests/e2e/growth-badge.spec.ts-snapshots/`.
Manual verification required for visual fidelity (color saturation, icon weight, mobile icon-only behavior) and a11y (WCAG-AA contrast against dark card background, screen-reader pronunciation of stage labels). Run `axe-core` via Playwright on a representative page with the new badge — expect zero new violations.
Production build smoke: `hugo --environment production` must render the badge correctly after PurgeCSS (verify the `[data-stage="…"]` selectors survive purge). Add to safelist only if a regression appears.

tests.ideas: - AC #1, #5 (card list): Homepage screenshot → assert `.card-footer-item.growth-stage` is the FIRST `.card-footer-item` child of every `.card-footer`. Snapshot to baseline. - AC #1, #5 (single page): Visit `/articles/{slug}/` for one article per stage → assert badge renders in the article header metadata cluster (right sidebar `.info.widget`). Snapshot. - AC #2 (icon mapping): For each stage, assert the rendered DOM contains the correct `ri-…-line` icon class AND the matching label text ("Seedling"/"Budding"/"Evergreen"/"Withered"). - AC #3 (icon color): Computed-style assertion or visual diff — `getComputedStyle(badge.querySelector('i')).color` matches the expected stage color (or rely on visual snapshot). - AC #4 (tooltip): Assert `title` attribute on `.growth-stage` wrapper contains the long description ("Seedling — early/draft content", etc.). - AC #6 (a11y): `axe-core` Playwright integration on a card-list page AND a single-page; expect zero new violations. Assert `i.aria-hidden === "true"`. - AC #7 (mobile): At viewport 375×667, assert `span` is `display: none` (computed style) AND the `title` tooltip is still present (preserves accessible label). Snapshot. - AC #8 (default fallback): Use a fixture article with NO `growth_stage` field (or remove the field temporarily). Assert badge renders with `data-stage="seedling"` and "Seedling" label. This is the regression guarantee for existing pre-1.1 content. - AC #9 (regression — top-right badges): For an article that's both `is-new` and has a category ribbon, snapshot the card and assert (visual diff) that `.is-new` and ribbon both still render at top corners — growth badge does NOT obscure or shift them. - AC #9 (regression — variants): Snapshot one card per variant: `.is-horizontal` (default), `.is-log`, `.has-image`, `.is-fixed`. Confirm growth badge renders in the footer of each without disrupting layout. - PurgeCSS regression: Run `hugo --environment production` then load the built `index.html` in a Playwright test — assert `.growth-stage` styles are applied (icon has expected color). Catches PurgeCSS over-stripping. - Build smoke: A test article with a valid `growth_stage` builds with `hugo --environment production` exit 0. Already covered by Story 1.1's build-smoke fixtures — no new build test needed for Story 1.2.
